task_instance: Build and verify a minimal NVIDIA PVA operator (correctness-only scope): perform a fresh PVA SDK L4T release build of an operator, inspect the compiler listing for vectorization, probe a directly connected Tegra over SSH, deploy the system-test executable, and run the filtered hardware correctness gtest matrix, producing the PASSED/FAILED/BLOCKED report and JSON per the skill's result schema.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable requires the NVIDIA public PVA SDK build toolchain (PVA_BUILD_MODE=L4T builds with the NVVPU or ASIP/Chess compiler backend, EMU mode, and the PVA_DISASSEMBLE compiler listing). That SDK is not installed on this workstation and cannot be obtained offline (no package registry, no downloads, no installs permitted). No Arm64/L4T cross-compiler (aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc) is present either. Beyond the SDK, two further intrinsic requirements cannot be met offline: (a) a directly connected Tegra device reached over SSH for the mandatory hardware-correctness and target-probe stages, which needs physical hardware plus network access that the air-gapped runtime forbids; and (b) a prerequisite upstream 'Doctor' report with a verified public-reference-corpus lock, which is an external input not supplied. The skill explicitly forbids substituting another host execution tool for EMU and forbids treating EMU or host results as hardware evidence, and the run rules forbid writing a stub/mock of the missing SDK, so no verifiable deliverable can be produced. Only the skill's own bundled reference/asset/template files are present; the missing pieces are the external SDK, cross toolchain, and hardware, not the skill's files.
